wedding.intro1: I'm a Vancouver-based photographer capturing love stories with depth and emotion, I'm here to preserve your most meaningful moments.
wedding.intro2: Whether it's the intimate emotion of an elopement, the joy of an engagement, or a shared moment on an ordinary day... these are once in a lifetime memories. They deserve to be captured with care and creativity, so you can relive them, share them, and pass them down for years to come.

process.heading: Our Process
process.s1d: Send me a message through the contact form with a few details about what you're planning. I'll reply with next steps
process.s2d: We get to know you and your vision. Locations, styles, mood boards
process.s3d: Professional equipment. I'll gently direct when needed, but mostly capture how things unfold naturally.
process.s5d: 1–2 weeks, you'll receive a private online gallery with your edited images

hero.subtitle: Painting together is how we slow down, find joy, and discover each other. Whether you've never picked up a brush or you paint every day... there is a seat for you at the table.

myExperiences.title: Curated Painting Events
myExperiences.subtitle: Intimate, beginner-friendly guided painting sessions where we create together step by step while enjoying drinks, music, and a warm atmosphere.

creativeCorner.title: A community for everyone who creates... or wants to.
creativeCorner.subtitle: This is not just a painting group. It's a gathering of curious, open-hearted people who come together through art. No experience needed. No judgment. Just brushes, colour, conversation, and warmth.
creativeCorner.pillar1Text: Guided sessions where everyone creates something beautiful... no experience necessary.
creativeCorner.pillar2Text: Meet people in Vancouver who share your love of creativity, calm, and meaningful moments.
creativeCorner.pillar3Text: Try new techniques, experiment with colour, and express yourself without pressure or judgment.
creativeCorner.pillar4Text: A welcoming space where everyone has a seat at the table... especially those who think they can't paint.
creativeCorner.testimonial1: I hadn't painted since elementary school. I was nervous. Then I walked in and felt immediately at home. By the end I had something on canvas I was genuinely proud of.
creativeCorner.testimonial2: The Creative Corner changed the way I spend my weekends. It's become my favourite way to disconnect and reconnect at the same time.
creativeCorner.for1: Wants to paint casually and joyfully
creativeCorner.for3: Needs a creative outlet and calm
creativeCorner.for4: Has never painted... and is curious
creativeCorner.for5: Wants to try something new and meaningful

youAndIPaint.title: you & i paint
youAndIPaint.body: I am proud to be an instructor for You & I Paint, a luxury paint & sip company known for elegant, elevated art experiences. I have led both public and private events for a wide range of audiences and occasions — from intimate celebrations to corporate events. From stylish venues to cozy private homes, every event is designed to inspire creativity and connection.
